fixes.explanation: Yes, baker! David says the LORD did it "…that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent." (Psalm 30:12) Think about that. The sackcloth comes off, and a heart that was weeping gets a song again. I'd say that's a heart that can't hold it in, like me when a fresh batch comes out of the oven. The mourning turned into dancing so the singing could start, and so it wouldn't stop.
